scientific_integrity: Universal proof uses the acyclic cycle-vertex incidence graph and quotient linear algebra. Finite code is supporting corroboration, not an infinite or external certificate. All statements, mathematical definitions and source dates independently checked for the new claim.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers finite connected simple cactus graphs only. No claim is made for general cycle-overlapping graphs. Special cases on forests, cycles and chordal graphs are already known. Full text of a related 2025 extended technical report was inaccessible; an unindexed equivalent may exist.
title: Cycle convexity on cactus graphs is a binary matroid closure
